trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is the reward for the full set, not a task in itself. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then side content, then collectibles, then cleanup, and tick each trophy off in the checklist below. Nothing in this list is permanently missable if mission replay exists; the checklist tracks all 54.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so just play the story from the start and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It is missable only in the sense that it belongs to this one mission — finish it when it comes up, and do not skip past it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the story missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of the chapter. It is tied to the chapter, so it cannot be earned in free roam — it comes from finishing the story, not from exploring.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Same approach as the other chapters: play the story missions in order until the chapter closes. The trophy is tied to the chapter, so it pops from story progress alone.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Play the story missions in order until the chapter ends. Tied to the chapter, so there is nothing extra to hunt down — finishing the story is the whole requirement.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The last chapter before the finale: play its story missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Tied to the chapter, so it comes from story progress alone.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the story finale, so play through to the end of the game. It is tied to the final mission itself — finish the story and it pops. One of only two gold trophies in the list.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it. The trophy belongs to that one mission, so do it when it comes up rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Play the story until the heist appears and finish it. The trophy is tied to this single mission, so it pops from story progress, not from free-roam crime.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it. Tied to this one mission, so it comes from story progress alone.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it. Tied to this one mission, so do it when it comes up.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. The name points at Vice City International Airport, so expect the action there — confirm the mission's setting in game. Play the story until the mission appears and finish it; the trophy belongs to this one mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it. Tied to this one mission, so it pops from story progress alone.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. This is the long one: the completion checklist covers the story plus side content, collectibles and activities, so save it for last — everything else in this guide feeds into it. Check the in-game completion list as you go and confirm in game how it counts each task. Insider Gaming counts 35 checklist tasks (reported via sixshore.com) — treat that as a cross-check, not a rule. One of only two gold trophies in the list.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); checklist-task count: Insider Gaming, via sixshore.com.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any stunt counts — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all feed the same counter (PowerPyx, via sixshore.com). Chain them during free-roam driving and flying; the counter is cumulative, so it builds up over the whole game. Not missable: stunts stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); stunt types: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The list counts 9 activity types (per the trophy listing) — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool and basketball are among them (PowerPyx, via sixshore.com). Sample one of each; you do not need to win or master any of them, just try them. Not missable: activities stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); activity examples: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges (per the trophy listing). Work through every range challenge and repeat any that fall short of gold — the ranges stay open, so this is a grind, not a missable. Learn each challenge's target pattern, then go for clean, fast runs.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 locations (per the trophy listing). Win one race at each; losing a race costs nothing but a retry, so learn each course's line and go again. Not missable: the races stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, boat or air, as the game offers them. Wins are cumulative across the game, so keep a note of which you have already won and pick new ones. Not missable: races stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — the better catch wins. Fishing is one of the activities, so the basics you learn here also feed Master of None. Not missable: the challenge can be retried.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk into an arcade, pick a game and see it through to the end. Any arcade game counts, so choose one you enjoy and finish it. Not missable: arcades stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops on the last one. It is tied to that final mission, so finish Andy's strand when it is offered rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Follow Kenton's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops on the last one. Tied to that final mission, so finish Kenton's strand when it is offered.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops on the last one. Tied to that final mission, so finish Billy's strand when it is offered.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; finish any 8 full strands. They can be done after the story, so nothing here is missable — but check which questlines count, since PowerPyx is still confirming the exact set (via sixshore.com).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); counting note: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops on the last one. Tied to that final mission, so finish Randy's strand when it is offered.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its end; the trophy pops on the last one. Tied to that final mission, so finish Tyrone's strand when it is offered.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots (per the trophy listing). Visit each one and meditate; the spots stay available, so work through them in free roam and use the map to find the ones you have not visited. Not missable.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a one-off quarry — follow his strand and take the animal down. Confirm the animal and the spot in game; the description names Bret, not the prey, so do not guess at either. Not missable: the hunt can be retried.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in total (PowerPyx, via sixshore.com), so any 3 complete sets will do. Collect cards as you explore and chase the missing ones — pick the three sets you are closest to finishing rather than starting new ones. Not missable: cards stay findable after the story.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); set count: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK phone app to tag 100 spots — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count (per sixshore.com's guide). Tag as you travel; the counter is cumulative, so it builds up naturally while you explore. Not missable.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); what counts: sixshore.com.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; any 50 count. They accumulate across activities, so keep an eye on the challenge list as you play and mop up the easy ones late in the game. Not missable.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Your partner must be with you, so do it in a mission or free roam where they are present. Repeatable, not missable.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner while keeping the wanted level alive — do not let it clear between robberies, and do not get caught. Plan a route with three close shops and move fast between them. Repeatable, not missable.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles — each new model you get into counts. Variety is the point: try everything you find, from cars to boats and bikes, and the counter climbs as you explore. Not missable.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies in range and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy fight and aim for grouped enemies; if you fall short, try again — it is repeatable, not missable.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in an unauthorised way — the description's own wording. Confirm the exact trigger in game (an airport stunt or a runway exit); it is a free-roam stunt, not a story moment, so it is repeatable and not missable.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks — the trophy is tied to them. Confirm the exact trigger in game; the description gives no number, so expect a tank encounter or a tank takedown rather than a counted grind. Do not chase it blindly until the trigger is confirmed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Pick a jewelry store, go in quiet and get out unseen — no alarms, no witnesses. Plan the approach, move slowly and leave before anyone spots you. If you are seen, walk away and try another store; it is repeatable, not missable.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4; there are 8 vaults in total (PowerPyx, via sixshore.com), so any 5 will do. Escape clean after each one. Not missable: the vaults stay available once opened.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); vault count and opener: PowerPyx, via sixshore.com.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away clean. Trucks appear in free roam, so watch the roads and strike when one is alone. Repeatable, not missable.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. There are 52 areas to visit (per the trophy listing). Drive, fly or walk into every named area; the map fills in as you go, so use it to spot the gaps and sweep them up in free roam. Not missable.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs (per the trophy listing). Hit one illegal operation for each of the nine — the operations are found by exploring gang territory, so confirm each gang's turf in game. Not missable: operations stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view and order a cocktail. A quiet moment, not a challenge — do it whenever you are passing through. Not missable.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's frontage and out the other side. Any showroom will do — confirm the exact spot in game, then hit it at speed. Repeatable, not missable.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game. The alley's name is in the description, so it is findable in game. Not missable: the alley stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description gives no concrete step — it reads as a partner-related milestone. Confirm the trigger in game before chasing it; do not grind blindly on a guess. Save it for the cleanup phase.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one (per the trophy listing), so it is about making choices — many of them — across the game. Keep playing and choosing; it pops on volume, not on one decision, so it should land naturally during a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description points at succeeding on a second attempt. Confirm the trigger in game — likely a retry of a failed attempt somewhere specific — rather than assuming any retry counts. Save it for cleanup and check the trigger first.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A strange-encounter trophy — the description is deliberately vague. Expect an unusual event somewhere in Leonida; confirm the trigger in game, and note that independent guides list this one as not yet known (gtavicecityhub.com). Do not grind for it blindly.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles); status: gtavicecityhub.com.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a bat or similar, not a gun. Bowling pins are the image; any pedestrian target counts (confirm in game). Repeatable, not missable.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Cumulative across the game — bank the bills as you earn them instead of sitting on them.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in total at shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything. Cumulative; it will mostly take care of itself by the late game, then top it up deliberately with big purchases.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties (per the trophy listing). Buy every one — save up, since property is the expensive part of the cleanup, and do it last when money is no longer tight.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 vehicles you own or find. Any 10 count; register as you discover new rides, and finish it off during cleanup.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official trophy list (PlayStation, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles).
